description: Notices from a building manager to tenants.

key.instructions: The tenant needs to be at home for this

not_key.instructions: The tenant does not need to be at home for this

s3.instructions: The notice is about a safety check

cases.state: The gas safety inspection is on Tuesday between 9 and 12. The engineer must be let in by the tenant; we do not hold a key.
The gas safety inspection is on Tuesday between 9 and 12. You don't need to be in: the engineer will use the management key and leave a report.
Window cleaners will do the outside of the building on Thursday. They work from a lift and never enter apartments.
Window cleaners will do the inside and outside of every window on Thursday. Please be home to let them in; they cannot use our key.
Smoke alarm testing next Monday. No need to stay home and no action required: staff will let themselves in with the master key.
Smoke alarm testing next Monday. Staff cannot use a master key this time, so please make sure you are at home between 10 and 2.
